newsitem.title: GERMANY: Walter Bau says 96 group profit 3.1 mln DM.
newsitem.headline: Walter Bau says 96 group profit 3.1 mln DM.

text.p: German construction group Walter Bau AG said on Tuesday its 1996 group net profit fell to 3.1 million marks ($1.8 million) from 21.9 million marks in the year before.
Income from ordinary activities in 1996 was 6.6 million marks, down from 20.05 million in 1995, the company said in a statement. Walter Bau says 96 group profit 3.1 million DM
Group output in 1996 rose 11 percent to 4.548 billion marks, while orders rose 26.6 percent to 5.193 billion marks.
Earnings fell to two marks per share, down from 15 marks per share in 1995.
Walter Bau planned to propose dividends of three marks per common share and four marks per preferred share -- down from seven marks per common share and eight marks per preferred share in 1995.
The company said it planned a resturcturing inlcuding cuts of 800 jobs to reduce costs after its average payroll rose to 12,550 in 1996, compared to 11,736 in 1995.

Walter Bau expected further negative developments in Germany in 1997 and probably even in 1998. It saw only a slight increase in domestic output this year as tax benefits for construction in east Germany have expired.
It said business was "satisfactory" in the first quarter, and forecast level 1997 profit from ordinary activities.
